def _gen_alias_field(self, state: GenState, crown: InpFieldCrown, field: InputField):
        keys = (state.path[-1], *crown.aliases)
        key_var = f"alias_key_{field.id}"
        present_var = f"alias_present_{field.id}"
        with state.builder(f"if not isinstance({state.parent.v_data}, CollectionsMapping):"):
            self._gen_raise_bad_type_error(state, f"TypeLoadError(CollectionsMapping, {state.parent.v_data})", namer=state.parent)
        state.type_checked_type_paths.add(state.parent_path)
        state.builder += f"{present_var} = [key for key in {keys!r} if key in {state.parent.v_data}]"
        with state.builder(f"if len({present_var}) > 1:"):
            state.builder += state.parent.emit_error(f"ExtraFieldsLoadError(set({present_var}[1:]), {state.parent.v_data})")
        with state.builder(f"if {present_var}:"):
            state.builder += f"{key_var} = {present_var}[0]"
            if self._is_packed_field(field) and not field.is_required:
                assign_to = f"packed_fields[{self._field_id_to_param[field.id].name!r}]"
            else:
                assign_to = state.v_field(field)
            loader = state.v_field_loader(field.id)
            expr = f"{state.parent.v_data}[{key_var}]"
            if self._field_loaders[field.id] != as_is_stub:
                expr = f"{loader}({expr})"
            if self._debug_trail in (DebugTrail.ALL, DebugTrail.FIRST):
                with state.builder("try:"):
                    state.builder += f"{assign_to} = {expr}"
                with state.builder("except Exception as e:"):
                    error = f"append_trail(e, {key_var})"
                    if state.parent_path:
                        error = state.parent.with_trail(error)
                    state.builder += f"errors.append({error})" if self._debug_trail == DebugTrail.ALL else f"raise {error}"
            else:
                state.builder += f"{assign_to} = {expr}"
        with state.builder("else:"):
            if field.is_required:
                error = f"NoRequiredFieldsLoadError({state.parent.v_required_keys} - set({state.parent.v_data}), {state.parent.v_data})"
                if self._debug_trail == DebugTrail.ALL:
                    with state.builder(f"if not {state.parent.v_has_not_found_error}:"):
                        state.builder += f"errors.append({state.parent.with_trail(error)})"
                        state.builder += f"{state.parent.v_has_not_found_error} = True"
                else:
                    state.builder += f"raise {state.parent.with_trail(error)}"
            elif self._is_packed_field(field):
                state.builder += "pass"
            else:
                state.builder += f"{state.v_field(field)} = {self._get_default_clause_expr(state, field)}"
